whats_new:
- New: IntraMind Assist. Draft and save purchase orders, sales orders, vendor bills (from a dropped PDF or photo), and new customers, vendors and parts into EBMS, entered as the signed-in EBMS user and only where writes are turned on. Review lists, search pickers, line editing, bill-to-PO matching and Open in EBMS links are included. Part import adds or updates parts in bulk.
- New: a redesigned layout with a dashboard on the left and the assistant on the right, role-based views (Owner, Purchaser, Sales) and pinned answers.
- New: user settings that follow the user, and company settings for EBMS Administrators.
- Changed: the tiers are now called IntraMind Insight and IntraMind Assist, and every user signs in with a named EBMS user.
- Changed: you must accept the Terms again after this update.
- Fixed: order totals use the unprocessed-order total, and a list of open sales-order lines totals each line correctly; other sales totals are unchanged.
- Fixed: users without access no longer see the Dashboard view control, and signing out clears Settings.
